objects.name: App::Document
objects.behavior: Owns the Part::Feature object and applies recompute so assigned shapes become observable document state.

objects.name: Part::Feature
objects.behavior: Document object whose Shape property stores a Part.Shape for recompute-aware document integration.

objects.name: Part.Shape
objects.behavior: Transient OpenCASCADE topology returned by Part factories and boolean operations before assignment to a document object.

properties.name: Shape
properties.behavior: Stores the generated Part.Shape on a document object so the model tree and recompute lifecycle can observe it.

properties.name: Volume
properties.behavior: Derived solid volume used to verify that generated topology is non-empty and changed by operations.

properties.name: Solids
properties.behavior: Sub-shape collection used to confirm representative solid topology exists.

examples.title: Create and integrate Part geometry headlessly
examples.summary: Creates representative Part solids, fuses them, assigns the result to a Part::Feature, recomputes, and verifies state.

workbenches.name: Part
workbenches.summary: Use the Part module for headless geometry construction, then integrate results through document objects when persistence or recompute matters.

anti_patterns.name: gui-command-reliance
anti_patterns.summary: Do not use GUI Part commands for automation-only geometry creation.
anti_patterns.guidance: Call Part module factories directly so scripts run under FreeCADCmd and in non-GUI CI.

anti_patterns.name: transient-shape-only
anti_patterns.summary: Do not leave geometry as an unowned transient shape when the workflow expects document state.
anti_patterns.guidance: Assign the generated shape to a Part::Feature.Shape property and recompute when the result should participate in the document lifecycle.

anti_patterns.name: skipped-recompute
anti_patterns.summary: Do not inspect document-integrated Part geometry before recompute.
anti_patterns.guidance: Call doc.recompute() after assigning Shape or mutating document object properties, then verify the resulting state.

anti_patterns.name: unchecked-topology
anti_patterns.summary: Do not pass generated topology downstream without basic shape validation.
anti_patterns.guidance: Use shape.isValid() and simple derived-state checks such as Volume or Solids for representative smoke coverage.

anti_patterns.name: label-name-confusion
anti_patterns.summary: Do not use Label for internal document lookup.
anti_patterns.guidance: Use the internal Name passed to addObject with doc.getObject(); Label is user-facing and can differ.

anti_patterns.name: mutating-derived-shape-assumption
anti_patterns.summary: Do not assume Part boolean helpers mutate the original shape in place.
anti_patterns.guidance: Store the returned shape from operations such as fuse() and assign that returned value to the document object.
